name: DocNexus Advanced Search MCP
description:
DocNexus turns real-world healthcare data into answers. This connector lets
Claude search DocNexus Advanced Search — a database built on de-identified US
medical and pharmacy claims — directly in your conversation.

Ask in plain English and Claude will find and rank the right people and
organizations, then explain what it found:

• Find individual providers (HCPs) by specialty, geography, affiliation, and
  what they diagnose, treat, or prescribe.
• Find healthcare executives and leadership at systems, hospitals, and firms.
• Rank the top providers or organizations by claim or patient volume for any
  clinical market (a diagnosis, procedure, or drug).
• Size a market — total claims or unique patients for a clinical definition.
• Chart patient-volume trends over time.
• See a provider's organizational affiliations.

Every query runs as your own DocNexus account, returning only data you already
have access to. Codes and names are resolved to canonical values automatically,
and results include the underlying query for full transparency.

This connector is a fast way to explore and qualify. Deeper workflows —
referral-network mapping, opportunity maps, exports, and saved lists — live in
the DocNexus platform, which the connector links you to when relevant.

You need a DocNexus platform account to use it.

_published_faq.name: How do I add DocNexus Advanced Search MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add DocNexus Advanced Search MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.docnexus.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the DocNexus Advanced Search MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: DocNexus Advanced Search MCP provides these MCP tools: find_executives, find_hcps, find_kols, find_referrals, hcp_affiliations, hcp_claim_volume, lookup_values, market_volume, opportunity_map, org_claim_volume, and patient_volume_trend.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to DocNexus Advanced Search MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to DocNexus Advanced Search MCP in health-life-sciences on the Manufact MCP catalog include Groupon, SNOMED CT Terminology, Rhizome AI - FDA & HA Regulatory Research, Aiva, and Amass Connector.

_published_faq.name: Does DocNexus Advanced Search MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: DocNexus Advanced Search MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops DocNexus Advanced Search MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: DocNexus Advanced Search MCP is developed by DocNexus AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
